messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert: api-gateway edge (eu-west) reporting sustained 502/504 spike. error-rate ~18% on /v1/*, 5xx count +300/min. Autopage -> @miguel_oncall, @jen_sre.
jen_sre: ack — I'm pulling telemetry, switching to ops channel.
miguel_oncall: oncall here, looking at ingress proxies and upstream pools. Noted a fanout surge to model-backend v2.
claire_eng: any deploys in the last 30m? CI shows no production deploys.
jen_sre: no deploys from platform team. Could be connection pool exhaustion or upstream timeouts.
miguel_oncall: running quick check:
```
curl -s -D - https://edge-eu-west.redwood/api/health | head -n 20
kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep model-backend
```
miguel_oncall: seeing a lot of 502s from mux -> model-backend, and 504s proxied from upstream. Conn reuse metrics show TIME_WAIT spike.
claire_eng: KV cache miss rate jumped too. Might be cold-cache effect after a prior TTL churn.
erin_support: Support: multiple customers (AcmeCorp, BetaApps) just opened incidents — calls time out client-side. They report ~10-15% failed requests.
dan_pm: SLO impact estimate? We need a short PS for customers.
jen_sre: SLO at risk for eu-west: errors up to 18% for /v1/generate over last 10m. Will prepare a brief status.
miguel_oncall: mitigation proposal: 1) enable dialback to reduce fanout to backend by 80% 2) activate circuit-breaker on model-backend v2 3) route a portion of traffic to v1 fallback pool 4) apply per-customer rate-limits for heavy clients.
jen_sre: executing dialback:
```
# apply dialback: reduce concurrent fanout
redwoodctl route update --edge eu-west --dialback 0.2 --reason "ingress 5xx surge"
```
jen_sre: dialback applied, reducing backend fanout.
miguel_oncall: flipping circuit-breaker for model-backend-v2:
```
redwoodctl policy set --service model-backend-v2 --circuit open --threshold 5xx:5m:5
```
miguel_oncall: circuit opened, traffic should fail fast to fallback.
claire_eng: started gradual traffic reroute to fallback-hosts, verifying responses.
erin_support: posted preliminary status to status.redwood.com: "Investigating elevated 5xx in eu-west, mitigation in progress. (AcmeCorp impacted)."
dan_pm: thanks — please include ETA: "mitigations in place, monitoring; next update in 15m."
jen_sre: also applied temporary per-client rate limit for top clients:
```
redwoodctl limit add --client AcmeCorp --rps 20
```
miguel_oncall: metrics: 5xx dropped from 18% -> 6% in first 3 minutes post-mitigation. p50 upstream latency back from 1.2s -> 360ms.
claire_eng: logs show backend pods had many accept() failures and keepalive drops. We're increasing connection pool sizes and keepalive in the target service config.
jen_sre: rolling restart of 3 affected pods scheduled to recover stale sockets: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-backend -n inference --cascade=none` (staggered).
erin_support: updated customer-facing note with mitigation steps and contact info.
dan_pm: remind CS to send targeted note to top-tier customers impacted.
miguel_oncall: error rate trending down to 2.3% past 10m window. Continuing to monitor for 30m before fully reverting dialback/circuit.
jen_sre: leaving dialback + circuit-breaker for 30m stabilization window, will plan a controlled rollback after 30m of <1% 5xx.
claire_eng: filing post-incident action: investigate cause of connection pool depletion and cache TTL churn. Suggested next steps: connection pooling tuning, fallback readiness test, and tighter fanout heuristics.
erin_support: AcmeCorp acknowledged update; they're still throttling retries client-side. No escalations to SEV yet.
dan_pm: good work — will call for a blameless RCA tomorrow 10:00 PT.
miguel_oncall: marking incident as stable for now. If no regressions in 15m we'll close the pager.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident is stable. Will auto-close if metrics remain steady for 15m.
jen_sre: adding final note: postmortem owner @claire_eng. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
